proof_body:
by
  intro A _ _ s f h
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing f with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha]
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr (h a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s))
    apply mul_dvd_mul_left
    apply ih
    intro b hb
    have h1 := h b (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hb)
    have hne : b - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun hab => ha (hab ▸ hb))
    simpa [hne] using h1
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] (s : Finset A) (f : Polynomial A), (∀ a ∈ s, f.eval a = 0) → (∏ a ∈ s, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a)) ∣ f
